tagline.en: A local, browsable archive of exported WhatsApp conversations — search, gallery and calendar, fully offline
tagline.pt: Arquivo local e navegável de conversas exportadas do WhatsApp — busca, galeria e calendário, 100% offline

notes.en:
Open `http://<host-ip>:8927` or `https://vaultzap.<your-tailnet>.ts.net`.

### Update

`AutoUpdate=registry` is on: the image updates on its own.
notes.pt:
Abrir `http://<ip-do-host>:8927` ou `https://vaultzap.<your-tailnet>.ts.net`.

### Atualizar

`AutoUpdate=registry` ligado: a imagem é atualizada sozinha.

upstream.note: The project tags its images but publishes no GitHub release, so the registry is what knows the latest one.
